Darius.escape: Engage when Darius E Apprehend has missed or is on cooldown. If no ally is nearby, don’t use all of Ornn E Searing Charge to engage; save it to disengage.
Darius.build: Darius’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Since you have to deal with both his basic attacks and the healing from Darius Q Decimate, build Thornmail earlier. Darius E Apprehend pierces some armor, and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so build health as well.
Darius.combo: After Darius E Apprehend is down, raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack to deal Brittle damage. If you’re already close enough to land Ornn W Bellows Breath before the knock-up, apply Brittle first to extend the crowd control from Ornn E Searing Charge.
Darius.fight: Only trade briefly when Darius E Apprehend is down, then disengage. The moment after Darius uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions is also an opportunity to harass. If the fight extends and Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance immediately.
Darius.laning: If Darius pushes the lane, farm under your turret. While he is away after recalling, finish items with Ornn P Living Forge, but don’t craft while Darius is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.
Darius.phase: In the late game, strengthen your whole team by granting available Masterwork upgrades to your main damage dealer and other allies.
Darius.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock Darius up with Ornn E Searing Charge and land Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open space, use Ornn R Call of the Forge God to send the spirit through him, then recast to send it back toward your allies and knock him up. Counter Darius’s engage instead of chasing him and leaving your damage dealers exposed. Don’t remain at low health with Hemorrhage stacks and give Darius R Noxian Guillotine a chance to reset.
Darius.watch: If Darius pulls you with Darius E Apprehend, he can follow with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so harass from outside E range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade’s edge or stay close to him to get hit by the handle. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to drop them; if you’re low on health with stacks applied, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Camille.phase: Fight with your allies in the mid game as you build two or three defensive items, and don’t leave a side lane open for Camille to quickly take a turret. In the late game, strengthen your team by granting allies the Masterwork upgrades from Ornn P Living Forge as soon as they become available.
Camille.build: Camille’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If you’re under constant pressure from her basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier to get healing reduction as well. Camille Q Precision Protocol’s true damage can’t be reduced by armor, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Camille.combo: For a short trade, land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with a basic attack. If Camille’s mobility ability is down, apply Brittle first, then knock her up by colliding with a pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture using Ornn E Searing Charge. If her mobility ability is still available and landing your abilities is the priority, lock her down first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Camille.escape: Look for an opening to engage when Camille E Hookshot is down, but account for the fact that she can also escape with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum if it is still available. In particular, before Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes back, close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God and land Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Camille.fight: Avoid fighting just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; trade damage after the shield disappears. When Camille E Hookshot or R The Hextech Ultimatum is down, land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then push her back with an empowered basic attack and deal damage. If no ally is nearby, don’t use all of Ornn E Searing Charge to engage.
Camille.laning: Stand between minions and away from walls, and farm a pushed-in wave under your turret. When Camille recalls, craft items with Ornn P Living Forge and stay in lane, but don’t craft while Camille is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.
Camille.teamfight: Ornn counters Camille’s engage in front of his damage dealers. In a passage with a wall, knock her up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then apply Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open space, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God first, then recast to send the spirit back and set up a knock-up.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from a long distance and stun you. Stand away from walls, and create distance while Camille prepares the second empowered basic attack from Camille Q Precision Protocol. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages, don’t waste crowd control; counterattack after the area ends.

Akali.fight: It’s difficult to land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath while Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, and Akali R Perfect Execution are available. Use Ornn W Bellows Breath when she has just used a mobility ability or is cornered against a wall, land the full cast, and trade with an empowered basic attack. If no ally is nearby, save Ornn E Searing Charge to disengage.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance before armor to deal with the damage from Akali P Assassin’s Mark, Akali Q Five Point Strike, and Akali E Shuriken Flip. Akali R Perfect Execution’s second hit deals more damage based on missing health, so build health as well. During a safe window, craft items in lane with Ornn P Living Forge.
Akali.combo: If Akali still has a mobility ability available, lock her down first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. After she uses a mobility ability, choose the pillar’s position with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock her up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge, followed by the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack. If you’re already close enough to land Ornn W Bellows Breath first, apply Brittle before the knock-up.
Akali.escape: Don’t engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Check whether Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution are also down, and especially close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God during the window before her ultimate comes back. Follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Akali.laning: If Akali pushes the lane, farm under your turret, and finish items with Ornn P Living Forge when it’s safe after she recalls.
Akali.phase: In the late game, strengthen your team by granting Masterwork upgrades to your main damage dealer and other allies as soon as they become available.
Akali.teamfight: Ornn counters Akali’s engage in front of his damage dealers. In a narrow passage with a wall, knock her up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then apply Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open space, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God so the spirit passes through her, recast to knock her up, then follow with Ornn E Searing Charge.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first projectile of Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, the second dash will follow even if you run, so if you’re hit, save Ornn E Searing Charge instead of using it to engage. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so be ready to respond with Ornn E Searing Charge.

Aurora.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock Aurora up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open space, sweep toward Aurora first with Ornn R Call of the Forge God to apply Brittle, then look for an Ornn E Searing Charge. This is your chance to counterengage if Aurora jumps in but fails to secure a takedown. Protect the space in front of your damage dealers without leaving low-health allies behind.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora still has a mobility ability, raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock her up first by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge, and follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Aurora is already close and has no mobility ability left to escape with, apply Brittle with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with a basic attack or the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. To knock an enemy up with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, summon the spirit and recast to headbutt the spirit.
Aurora.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration, Aurora Q Twofold Hex, and Aurora E The Weirding. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone. If her healing prolongs fights, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it into Morellonomicon.
Aurora.escape: The opening to engage comes after Aurora has used both Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding. If Aurora becomes stealthed, don’t rush your abilities; watch for where she will reappear.
Aurora.fight: If Aurora W Across the Veil, Aurora E The Weirding, and Aurora R Between Worlds are still available, don’t go deep just because she used one mobility ability. Approach so the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath hits right after she uses a mobility ability, then deal extra damage with a basic attack once she is Brittle. If no ally is nearby, save Ornn E Searing Charge so you can disengage.
Aurora.laning: If Aurora pushes the lane, farm under your turret, and finish items with Ornn P Living Forge when she recalls. Crafting takes time, so don’t use it while Aurora is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, strengthen your team by granting Masterwork upgrades to completed items for your main damage dealer and other allies.
Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when its curse is pulled back, and that damage increases with the amount of missing health. If you’re cursed, move out of the line connecting you to Aurora, and back away before the curse returns when health is low. Move away before the area from Aurora R Between Worlds unfolds, or find an angle to fight inside it.

Aatrox.laning: Farm safely with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and keep pace in CS and levels. If Aatrox pushes the lane, farm under your turret, and finish items with Ornn P Living Forge while he recalls. Crafting takes time, so don’t craft while Aatrox is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If his healing makes him difficult to kill in extended fights, get healing reduction and upgrade Oblivion Orb into Morellonomicon to suit Ornn’s magic damage. If you keep getting hit by Aatrox’s empowered basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier.
Aatrox.combo: If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to raise a pillar, then knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack. If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is still available and landing your abilities is the priority, first lock him down with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then land Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you make Aatrox use Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath when Aatrox can no longer escape with a mobility ability. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, leave the area first and save Ornn E Searing Charge for when you need it.
Aatrox.fight: Don’t force trades early. Look for an opening right after Aatrox uses his Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance empowered basic attack on a minion or after he uses Aatrox E Umbral Dash. When you get close, land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with an empowered basic attack.
Aatrox.phase: In the late game, strengthen your team by granting your allies Masterwork item upgrades.
Aatrox.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock enemies up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then apply Brittle with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open space, use Ornn R Call of the Forge God to send the spirit through enemies, then look for an angle to knock them up on the recast. Counter Aatrox’s engage while protecting the space in front of your damage dealers.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals his main damage and can knock you up, so when you see the cast, dodge toward the area just outside or inside the blade’s edge. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, walk out of the area immediately and use your saved Ornn E Searing Charge if needed.

Malphite.watch: Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you, making it hard to engage or disengage, so don’t start a trade immediately after being hit. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash that Ornn’s crowd control cannot interrupt. When Malphite’s location is unknown, watch behind walls and in bushes, and don’t stand close to your allies.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first to reduce Malphite’s main damage. Keep in mind that the physical damage from Malphite W Thunderclap isn’t reduced by magic resistance. If Malphite stacks armor, use the maximum-health damage from Ornn W Bellows Breath instead of trying to break through head-on.
Malphite.combo: A standard engage is to raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock Malphite up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. If Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down and you can already get close, hit the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and trigger Brittle with a basic attack. If Malphite still has R and you need to secure a hit, lock him down first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with W.
Malphite.escape: The opening to engage is right after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down. Close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God and hit Ornn W Bellows Breath. Don’t engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you.
Malphite.fight: Early on, prioritize safe farming over forced trades. If Malphite P Granite Shield is still up, break it first, and don’t start a trade right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard slows you. When Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down, close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge and follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack.
Malphite.laning: If Malphite pushes the lane, farm under your turret and use Ornn P Living Forge to finish an item when he recalls. Crafting takes time, so don’t craft while Malphite is nearby or the jungler’s position is unclear.
Malphite.phase: Midgame, while you’re building two or three defensive items, is when Ornn’s strength comes online. In the late game, provide Masterwork upgrades to allies to increase your team’s power.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock up multiple people at once. After Malphite engages with R, intercept him in front of your team’s damage dealers and focus your counterattack. In corridors with walls, knock him up by colliding with a wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.

Quinn.build: Quinn deals mostly physical damage and chips away at Ornn with basic attacks, so build Thornmail earlier. Prioritize armor over magic resistance.
Quinn.combo: After Quinn E Vault is down, cast Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to create a pillar, then knock her up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with an empowered basic attack. If Quinn can still dodge Ornn E Searing Charge, knock her up first to ensure it lands, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is down is your window to close the gap. Engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Quinn E Vault is still available, don’t engage first on your own.
Quinn.fight: Don’t try to engage Quinn alone early. Trade when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives. Once you’re on her, land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with an empowered basic attack.
Quinn.laning: Don’t overreach for an advantage within Quinn’s range; use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to farm safely and keep up in levels. When Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off and farm while the mark is absent. If Quinn pushes the wave, farm under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to craft items when it’s safe.
Quinn.phase: In the late game, provide Masterwork upgrades to your allies and lead team fights.
Quinn.teamfight: Guard the space in front of your carries, and if Quinn comes in from the side, intercept her with the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. In a narrow passage with a wall, knock her up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of her basic attack range so she can’t hit you with an empowered attack. Quinn E Vault knocks Ornn back and lets Quinn retreat, so don’t force your way in before she uses it. Stand behind a line of minions against Quinn Q Blinding Assault so a minion is the first target. If your vision is reduced, don’t cast abilities during that time.

Chogath.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance can’t block the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, but E Vorpal Spikes deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid a build that only stacks health. If Cho'Gath P Carnivore’s healing makes him difficult to kill in extended fights, buy Oblivion Orb and upgrade it into Morellonomicon.
Chogath.combo: If Cho'Gath Q Rupture is down, choose the pillar’s position with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and trigger Brittle with a basic attack. If you’re already close enough to land it, apply Brittle first with W Bellows Breath, then follow with the knock-up from E Searing Charge.
Chogath.escape: The chance to engage comes right after you dodge Cho'Gath Q Rupture or see him use it on the wave. Engage after avoiding the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream; if you’re silenced, walk out instead of trying to cast abilities. Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, so once you catch him, stay positioned to land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Chogath.fight: Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, so if Q Rupture is down, close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God and land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Chogath.laning: Use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to safely keep pace in CS and levels, but don’t stand in a straight line behind minions that Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes can pierce. To slow Cho'Gath’s growth, look for a chance to pressure him after he uses Q Rupture on the wave, but don’t force fights while you’re weak early. When Cho'Gath recalls, craft items with Ornn P Living Forge and stay in lane.
Chogath.phase: Ornn’s damage is low early, so farm safely while pressuring Cho'Gath where possible to limit the time he has to build stacks. Direct fights against Cho'Gath become less favorable as the game goes on, so focus on your allies’ Masterwork upgrades and teamfight contribution in the late game.
Chogath.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock up the target with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with W Bellows Breath. In open space, cast R Call of the Forge God first so the spirit passes through the opponent, then follow with E Searing Charge. If your health gets low enough for Cho'Gath R Feast to execute you, keep your distance. Counter the enemy’s engage in front of your damage dealers.
Chogath.watch: When Cho'Gath Q Rupture is telegraphed beneath you, immediately dodge to the side and use Ornn E Searing Charge if needed. If you’re hit by the frontal silence from Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, you can’t cast abilities, so walk out of its area first. If you’re at or below half health, keep your distance to avoid Cho'Gath R Feast, which armor can’t block.

DrMundo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. Also keep in mind that armor can’t block the magic damage from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper. If his healing prolongs fights, build resistance first, then get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it into Morellonomicon.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and use the knockback from an empowered basic attack to remove his passive first. Then raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. For Ornn R Call of the Forge God, let the initially summoned spirit pass through Dr. Mundo, then recast to headbutt the spirit and knock Dr. Mundo up.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you’ve removed his passive and have an angle to catch him, engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw prevents your engage, use Ornn W Bellows Breath, which makes you unstoppable while moving forward. If no ally is nearby, don’t use all of Ornn E Searing Charge to engage and leave yourself without a way to disengage.
DrMundo.fight: Don’t force a duel early; look for an opportunity while blocking Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions. When you trade, land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then an empowered basic attack. When Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is unavailable, look for an opportunity to catch him with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
DrMundo.laning: If the lane is pushing toward you, farm under your turret. When Dr. Mundo recalls, finish items with P Living Forge and stay in lane. Crafting takes time, so don’t craft while Dr. Mundo is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unknown. If Dr. Mundo drops a canister after a trade, step on it as you retreat to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Ornn’s abilities have long cooldowns and his damage is low early, so protect your CS and levels instead of trying to take Dr. Mundo down. In the late game, strengthen your team by granting Masterwork upgrades to your allies’ completed items.
DrMundo.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, look for an angle to knock Dr. Mundo up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then land Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, account for its ability to ignore the first immobilizing effect when choosing the order of your key knock-ups. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, protect the space in front of your damage dealers and counter other enemies’ engages instead of spending time trying to kill him.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw only hits the first target it strikes and deals damage based on current health, so stand behind minions, especially when you’re at high health. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so don’t lead with the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God while his passive is available. When Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, his healing and movement speed increase, so don’t spend time trying to kill him.

Fiora.build: Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If her basic attacks wear you down over time, build Thornmail earlier to get healing reduction as well. The true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge can’t be blocked by armor, and Fiora R Grand Challenge deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health.
Fiora.combo: If Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down, apply Brittle with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then knock her up by colliding with a pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture using Ornn E Searing Charge. For a short trade, use Ornn W Bellows Breath → empowered basic attack. If Fiora Q Lunge is still available, she can escape with it, so don’t lead with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Fiora.escape: Right after you make Fiora use Fiora Q Lunge is your chance to close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Once you confirm Fiora W Riposte is also down, use a knock-up, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath to make it difficult for Fiora to escape.
Fiora.fight: Read which direction Fiora Q Lunge will come from based on her vital marker, stand on the opposite side of the vital, and briefly counterattack right after she engages. After Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down, land the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and trade with an empowered basic attack. Don’t chase too far after the trade.
Fiora.laning: If Fiora pushes the lane, farm under your turret, and finish items with Ornn P Living Forge when she recalls. Avoid crafting while Fiora is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unknown.
Fiora.phase: In the late game, don’t duel Fiora alone in a side lane; group with allies to catch her or start a teamfight, and use available Masterwork upgrades on your allies.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, press against a wall so you don’t expose all four vitals. Ornn counters Fiora’s engage in front of his damage dealers, and after Fiora W Riposte is down, knock her up by colliding with terrain using Ornn E Searing Charge. In open space, first slow her and apply Brittle with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then look for a follow-up knock-up.

Gangplank.build: Build armor first, starting in the laning phase, against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg. Also build health to withstand true damage. If trades drag on because of the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Gangplank.combo: Right after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to set up a pillar, then look for an angle to knock him up by charging into it with Ornn E Searing Charge. If you are already close, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and follow up with an empowered attack. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is still available, it is better to use your key knockups, Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, after that ability is down.
Gangplank.escape: The moment after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed is your chance to engage; back off if there is a primed keg nearby. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God when an opening appears. If your allies are not nearby, do not spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely on engaging, so you still have an escape.
Gangplank.fight: Trade when Gangplank E Powder Keg has just been placed and is not primed yet. If you need to push through the slow from Gangplank E Powder Keg or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage, use Ornn W Bellows Breath, which makes you unstoppable while advancing. Hit with the final flame, then follow up with an empowered attack for extra damage.
Gangplank.laning: If Gangplank pushes the wave, farm safely under your tower. While Gangplank is away after recalling, craft an item with Ornn P Living Forge, but do not craft if the enemy is nearby or the jungler's location is unknown.
Gangplank.phase: Mid game, as you build two or three defensive items, is Ornn's real power spike. In the late game, strengthen the team by granting Masterwork upgrades to your allies.
Gangplank.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock the enemy up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow up with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open areas, sweep through the enemy with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then look for an angle to headbutt the spirit back and knock them up. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, land your key crowd control. Stand in front of your allied damage dealers to protect them and counter the enemy's engage.
Gangplank.watch: When Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, back off and stay out of spots where two kegs overlap. If you destroy a keg directly from outside its blast radius, it will not explode. Resistances cannot block the true damage from Gangplank P Trial by Fire or Gangplank R Cannon Barrage.

Garen.build: Build armor first because the main damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment is physical. Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so build health too. If the healing from Garen P Perseverance makes it hard to finish him with damage over time, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Garen.combo: In short trades, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with an empowered attack. If you have an angle for a knockup, charge into a pillar raised by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture with Ornn E Searing Charge. If Garen just activated W Courage, delay the knockup from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God by half a beat.
Garen.escape: Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so the window to engage is after his empowered attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is used. Once the brief shield and tenacity from Garen W Courage have also worn off, catch him with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If your allies are not nearby, do not spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely on engaging; save it as an escape.
Garen.fight: Trade briefly just after the empowered attack from Garen Q Decisive Strike is used on a minion or otherwise consumed. Right after Garen activates W Courage, he has a shield and tenacity, so wait half a beat before using Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn E Searing Charge. Do not stay in close combat for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning.
Garen.laning: Garen gets stronger as the game goes on, so pressure him when Garen Q Decisive Strike is down and deny him room to scale. If the wave is pushing toward you, farm under your tower; while the enemy is away after recalling, finish an item with Ornn P Living Forge.
Garen.phase: Garen W Courage's stacks make the matchup harder as the game goes on, but late-game Ornn contributes to the team by upgrading allies' Masterwork items.
Garen.teamfight: Stand in front of your allied damage dealers to protect them and counter Garen's engage. In a narrow passage, knock him up by charging into the terrain with Ornn E Searing Charge, then layer Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open areas, let the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God pass through the enemy, then recast it to knock them up. Avoid the brief tenacity window right after Garen W Courage.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his next attack and silences you, preventing Ornn from retaliating, so do not engage first while Garen still has it. Staying close to Garen E Judgment puts you at a greater disadvantage, so stay outside its spin range. If you are below half health, beware Garen R Demacian Justice and stay out of its range.

Gnar.build: Build armor first to reduce Gnar's main damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on max health, so be cautious about relying on stacking health alone. If Mini Gnar keeps harassing you with basic attacks, rush Thornmail.
Gnar.combo: If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then charge into it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then use a basic attack to trigger Brittle. If Gnar still has his mobility ability, catch him first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Gnar.escape: Immediately after you force Gnar to use Gnar E Hop / Crunch is your window to engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If Gnar R GNAR! is also down, you can fight near a wall with less risk of being knocked into it and stunned. Engage just after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar, while he cannot transform again.
Gnar.fight: Do not force trades against Mini Gnar's harassment; close the gap right after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used. Once you are close, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trade with a basic attack. Avoid fighting head-on right after Gnar transforms into Mega Gnar, and create some distance.
Gnar.laning: Early on, safely last-hit with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture while keeping up in CS and levels. If Gnar pushes the wave, farm near your tower; while Gnar is away after recalling, finish an item with Ornn P Living Forge. Crafting takes time, so do not use it while Gnar is nearby or the enemy jungler's location is unknown.
Gnar.phase: In the late game, prioritize Masterwork upgrades for your team's main damage dealer to strengthen the team.
Gnar.teamfight: If Gnar R GNAR! is available, do not start a team fight in a narrow space with your back to a wall. Just after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini Gnar, engage with your team and look for an angle to recast Ornn R Call of the Forge God to knock enemies toward your allies. Stand in front of your allied damage dealers and counter enemy engages. When you have a safe angle near terrain, knock the enemy up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Gnar.watch: The boomerang from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit you on its return, so step out of its path. If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is available, he can dodge the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath. When Mega Gnar can cast Gnar R GNAR!, do not stand with your back to a wall.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first with items like Spectre's Cowl against Gwen's main damage, and build armor against her basic attacks. If her healing makes it hard to finish her with Ornn's damage over time, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Gwen.combo: If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is available, catch her first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Gwen is already close, apply Brittle with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow up with an empowered attack or a knockup. In open terrain, when using Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture → Ornn E Searing Charge, choose where the Q pillar will appear before charging.
Gwen.escape: Engage just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash goes on cooldown. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash gets a large cooldown refund if it hits something, so when there are many minions around, prepare immobilizing crowd control instead of chasing her in.
Gwen.fight: Immediately after you force Gwen to use Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is your chance to close the gap. Engage then with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trade with an empowered attack. Move to the side to avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.laning: If Gwen pushes the wave, farm under your tower; when Gwen recalls, finish an item with Ornn P Living Forge. Crafting takes time, so do not use it while Gwen is nearby or the jungler's location is unknown.
Gwen.phase: In the late game, strengthen the team by granting Masterwork upgrades to allies' completed items.
Gwen.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock the enemy up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow up with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open areas, let the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God pass through the enemy, then look for an angle to headbutt the spirit back and knock them up. If Gwen engages, counter her in front of your allied damage dealers and stay out of the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: The center of the cone of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so walk to the side to get out of the center. Gwen P A Thousand Cuts and Gwen R Needlework deal damage based on max health, so do not try to survive by stacking health alone. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target her from outside the mist, so enter it or wait for it to end.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Illaoi Q Tentacle Smash, and Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. If healing from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God is a problem, buy Oblivion Orb to complement Ornn's magic damage and upgrade it to Morellonomicon. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on max health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Illaoi.combo: Right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used, place a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture where you want to engage, then charge into it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock her up. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then use a basic attack to trigger Brittle. If Illaoi is already close and a longer knockup is preferable, apply Brittle first with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then knock her up with Ornn E Searing Charge.
Illaoi.escape: Engage just after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, her mobility ability, goes on cooldown. If Illaoi E Test of Spirit also misses, close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Illaoi.fight: The moment after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is used is your chance to close the gap. If Illaoi E Test of Spirit also misses, engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then finish the trade with a basic attack.
Illaoi.laning: Early on, safely farm with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture while keeping up in CS and levels. Keep the wave away from tentacles near walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit's range. If the enemy pushes the wave, farm under your tower; craft an item with Ornn P Living Forge when it is safe.
Illaoi.phase: In the late game, strengthen the team by upgrading your main damage dealer's Masterwork item.
Illaoi.teamfight: Do not fight near walls where Illaoi's tentacles are; destroy the tentacles or draw her into open ground. When Illaoi R Leap of Faith is cast, spread out to reduce the number of targets hit and wait out its duration. Stand in front of your allied damage dealers and counter enemy engages; in a passage with a wall, chain the knockup from Ornn E Searing Charge into Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit pulls out a spirit and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range and move after it misses. Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals heavy damage in a short time and spawns a tentacle for each champion hit, so do not group up in front of her and keep your distance for the duration.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. Since her damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, reducing her attack speed is also effective. If the healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge makes her hard to take down in extended fights, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Irelia.combo: If Irelia Q Bladesurge is available, catch her first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow up with Ornn W Bellows Breath. Right after she uses Q, choose where to raise a pillar and cast Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture; you can then charge into that pillar with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock her up. If Irelia is already close, apply Brittle with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow up with a basic attack or a knockup.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge is your window to engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun is also down, close in during that opening and hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Irelia.fight: Look for a short trade just after Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge. Once you are close, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and follow up with an empowered attack. If your allies are not nearby, do not spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely on engaging.
Irelia.laning: Early on, safely farm with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture while keeping up in CS and levels. Do not leave low-health minions between you and Irelia; if the enemy pushes the wave, farm under your tower. While Irelia is away after recalling, stay in lane and craft an item with Ornn P Living Forge from a safe spot.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, strengthen the team by granting Masterwork upgrades to allies' completed items as soon as they become available.
Irelia.teamfight: When Irelia engages, counter her in front of your allied damage dealers and prioritize crowd control. In a passage with a wall, knock her up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open areas, sweep through her with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then look for an angle to recast it and knock her up.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain across low-health minions to close the gap and also heals her. Create distance when minions are close to dying, and beware the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped inside the boundary of Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait for the blades to disappear.

Jax.build: Build defensive items first, with both physical and magic resistance. Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so reducing his attack speed is effective. Avoid relying on stacking health alone, considering the max-health-based damage from Jax E Counter Strike.
Jax.combo: After Jax Q Leap Strike is down, raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then charge into it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up. If Jax E Counter Strike has ended, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then use a basic attack to trigger Brittle.
Jax.escape: The moment after Jax Q Leap Strike is used is your chance to engage. If Jax E Counter Strike is still available, wait outside its stun range for it to end, then engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God once both abilities are down.
Jax.fight: Do not use Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God first just because Jax E Counter Strike is active. Close the gap just after Jax Q Leap Strike is used, especially once E Counter Strike also ends, and hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Jax.laning: If the wave is pushing toward you, farm under your tower; while Jax is away after recalling, finish an item with Ornn P Living Forge. Avoid crafting while Jax is nearby or the enemy jungler's location is unknown.
Jax.phase: In the late game, strengthen the whole team with Ornn's Masterwork upgrades.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps on your allied damage dealer, do not group up around them; focus crowd control just after the area stun from Jax E Counter Strike ends. Use terrain to knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge or counter his engage with Ornn R Call of the Forge God while standing in front of your allied damage dealers to protect them. If Jax is pushing a side lane tower, split your forces and trade for an objective instead of forcing a one-on-one fight.
Jax.watch: Jax can close the gap with Jax Q Leap Strike, so save Ornn E Searing Charge to disengage.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against Jayce's main damage from Jayce W Lightning Field and Jayce E Thundering Blow. Jayce Q Shock Blast deals physical damage, so magic resistance cannot block it; Jayce E Thundering Blow deals damage based on max health, so avoid relying on stacking health alone.
Jayce.combo: After Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, choose where to raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then charge into it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then use a basic attack to trigger Brittle. If Jayce can still leap, catch him first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Jayce.escape: The moment after Jayce Q To the Skies!'s leap is used is your chance to engage. If Jayce E Thundering Blow's knockback would stop your engage, use Ornn W Bellows Breath, which makes you unstoppable while advancing. If your allies are not nearby, do not spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely on engaging; save it as an escape.
Jayce.fight: Do not trade aggressively with Jayce early. Right after he uses Jayce Q To the Skies!, close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge, hit with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then finish with a basic attack.
Jayce.laning: Jayce is strong early, so safely farm with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture while keeping up in CS and levels. Move side to side to anticipate Jayce Q Shock Blast, and farm under your tower if the wave is pushing toward you. Once Jayce has recalled, craft an item with Ornn P Living Forge when it is safe.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so Ornn should farm defensively. In the late game, strengthen the team with Ornn's Masterwork upgrades on allies' completed items.
Jayce.teamfight: Engage after Jayce Q To the Skies!'s leap is down. In a narrow passage with a wall, knock him up by charging into the wall with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. Fight in front of your allied damage dealers while countering Jayce's engage.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast may be coming, so sidestep out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, beware the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kayle.build: Build magic resistance first against Kayle’s damage. It’s also important to dodge Kayle Q Radiant Blast, which reduces your resistances when it hits. If Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s healing makes her hard to take down in extended fights, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Kayle.combo: On open ground, place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock Kayle up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered attack. If you’re already on Kayle, first apply Brittle with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then knock her up to get more value from the crowd control.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no self-peel mobility, so a good time to engage is after Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or she uses Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Slow her with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and lock her down with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If your team can’t follow up, don’t use all of Ornn E Searing Charge to engage.
Kayle.fight: After Kayle Q Radiant Blast misses or Kayle uses W Celestial Blessing, slow her with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge. Once in range, hit the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow up with an empowered attack.
Kayle.laning: Farm the lane Kayle has pushed in under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to craft items when it’s safe.
Kayle.teamfight: Look for an angle to reach Kayle from the flank or out of vision when your allies’ crowd control is applied alongside yours. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, lock her down with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God and let her invulnerability expire before dealing damage.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so avoid taking a direct hit. If Kayle W Celestial Blessing gives her movement speed, the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath can miss. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t unload your damage; let the duration run out with crowd control.

Kled.build: Kled’s main damage is physical, and he attacks with basic attacks over time, so build armor first and buy Thornmail earlier. Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deals magic damage that armor won’t block, while Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid building heavily into health alone.
Kled.combo: If Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is still available, knock him up first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath. If his mobility is down and he’s close, apply Brittle with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge. Where there’s no wall, raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and collide with it using Ornn E Searing Charge.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage hastily when only Kled E Jousting is down; he can escape with Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. Close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God during the window when both mobility tools are down, then use Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use Ornn E Searing Charge to create distance before it pulls you in.
Kled.fight: Don’t take all four attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies in an extended fight; disengage and re-engage for a short trade. After Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, hit the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and trade damage with an empowered attack.
Kled.laning: If the opponent pushes, farm under your turret and use Ornn P Living Forge to finish an item when it’s safe, then stay in lane. If Kled has dismounted from Skaarl, check his Courage bar, and keep your distance to prevent him from building Courage when you can’t be sure of killing him.
Kled.phase: Early on, Ornn’s abilities have long cooldowns and deal little damage, so stay alive without giving Kled an advantage. In the late game, extend the game and increase your team’s power with your allies’ Masterwork upgrades.
Kled.teamfight: Keep side vision to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! from long range, and stand in front to protect your team’s back line. In narrow corridors, knock him up by colliding with a wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then layer Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open areas, sweep through the enemy with Ornn R Call of the Forge God and strike the elemental to redirect it, then deal with the diving Kled with your team.
Kled.watch: If Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, much of its damage based on your maximum health comes on the fourth attack, so don’t stay in range long enough to take all four. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, immediately create distance before it pulls you in, and watch whether Kled can chase with Kled E Jousting or Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main source of damage. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so don’t stand in the area, and Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t focus too heavily on building health alone. When crafting with Ornn P Living Forge, choose a time when Nasus is away and the jungler’s position is known.
Nasus.combo: Place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture where you want it, then knock Nasus up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. If Nasus is already close, apply Brittle with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then use an empowered attack. If you have an angle to extend the knockup duration, apply Brittle first, then follow with the knockup from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no way to create distance on his own besides Flash, so engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God when you have an opening to catch him. Look for a window when Nasus W Wither is down, and if you need to approach through the slow, use Ornn W Bellows Breath, which makes you unstoppable while advancing. If your allies aren’t nearby, don’t use all of Ornn E Searing Charge to engage.
Nasus.fight: For a short trade, hit the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then finish with an empowered attack. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, stop fighting unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: If you push the lane to Nasus’s turret, it becomes easier for him to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Let the lane come toward you and farm safely with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture while keeping up in CS and levels. Place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture where Nasus needs to step to last-hit, and create an opportunity to call for a gank.
Nasus.phase: In the late game, Nasus becomes harder to deal with as his stacks grow, so avoid fighting him alone and increase your team’s power with Ornn’s Masterwork upgrades.
Nasus.teamfight: While Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, keep your distance instead of standing your ground unless you have a clear advantage. Ornn should intercept Nasus’s engage in front of the team’s damage dealers; in corridors with walls, knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open areas, first sweep Nasus with Ornn R Call of the Forge God and look for an angle to strike the spirit, redirect it, and knock Nasus up.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike becomes more threatening as it stacks, so don’t let him farm last hits freely. If you’re alone while affected by Nasus W Wither, it’s hard to escape, so don’t move alone within its range. When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, avoid fighting and let it run out unless you have a clear advantage in both numbers and damage output.

Olaf.build: Build armor first against Olaf Q Undertow and his basic attacks. If he’s hitting you with basic attacks over an extended fight, buy Thornmail earlier for its reflected damage and healing reduction. Resistances don’t work against the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so get health as well.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, hit the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and push him back with an empowered attack for extra damage. If you also want a knockup, apply Brittle with W, then collide with the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture using Ornn E Searing Charge. If you need to catch him first, knock him up with Q → E, then hit W’s final flame.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no separate escape ability, so engage when Olaf R Ragnarok ends and he hasn’t picked up the axe from Olaf Q Undertow. Raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If your allies aren’t nearby, don’t use all of E to engage; save it as an escape tool.
Olaf.fight: Early on, don’t initiate a prolonged close-range fight; farm from a distance with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. Dodge Olaf Q Undertow and move out of the axe pickup path, then trade briefly after Olaf R Ragnarok ends. Even as Olaf’s health decreases, his attack speed and life steal become stronger, so don’t overcommit to finish him.
Olaf.laning: If Olaf pushes the lane, farm under your turret and move to the opposite side from where his thrown axe lands. After Olaf recalls, craft an item with Ornn P Living Forge from a safe position and stay in lane.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early, so safely keep up in CS and levels without giving him a kill. In the late game, upgrade completed items for your team’s main damage dealers into Masterwork items to increase your team’s power.
Olaf.teamfight: When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance behind a wall or your allies, then knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God as soon as it ends. In narrow corridors with walls, knock him up by colliding with a wall using E, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. Intercept Olaf’s engage in front of your team’s damage dealers instead of chasing the enemy back line.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move to the opposite side from where the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, the knockups from Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God won’t work, so create distance. If Olaf keeps hitting you with basic attacks or Olaf E Reckless Swing during this time, R’s duration is extended, and E’s true damage can’t be reduced by armor.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon’s main damage. If he keeps chipping you down with basic attacks, get Thornmail earlier. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, and Pantheon R Grand Starfall has armor penetration, so avoid blindly stacking only health or armor.
Pantheon.combo: If Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, use Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up by colliding with the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath and basic attacks. If Pantheon is already on you and has used his escape, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with a basic attack or the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. To place the pillar where you want it, deliberately aim Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture slightly to the side of Pantheon.
Pantheon.escape: The window to engage opens after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, and he has fewer ways to escape if Pantheon R Grand Starfall is not available yet. Close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, consider whether he can escape with Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid head-on damage exchanges early, and look for a trade when Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. If he is already on you, land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with an empowered basic attack for extra damage. If no ally is nearby, save Ornn E Searing Charge to disengage.
Pantheon.laning: Stand behind minions when Pantheon uses Q Comet Spear to poke. If the wave pushes toward you, farm under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to finish items while Pantheon is away after recalling.
Pantheon.phase: As Pantheon’s influence wanes in the late game, empower your team with Ornn’s Masterwork upgrades.
Pantheon.teamfight: Intercept Pantheon’s engage in front of your carries. In a passage with a wall, knock him up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then overlap it with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God so the elemental passes through the enemies, then look for a knock-up angle when you recast it.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so stay out of its range. Use minions to block Pantheon Q Comet Spear. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, hold off on attacking him from the front and hit him after it ends. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to mitigate Poppy’s main damage. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so avoid building heavily into health alone, and don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: In open terrain, choose where to place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and cast it. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, knock her up by colliding with the pillar using Ornn E Searing Charge. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is still available, first lock her down with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Poppy is already on you, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with an empowered basic attack or a knock-up.
Poppy.escape: Look to engage right after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait to use the dashes from Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If Poppy charges R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her frontal path, then look for another angle.
Poppy.fight: The moment after Poppy E Heroic Charge is down is your chance to close the gap. Once Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trade with an empowered basic attack.
Poppy.laning: Stand in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t pin you against a wall, and leave the area left by Poppy Q Hammer Shock immediately. Use Ornn P Living Forge to craft items while Poppy is away after recalling, but don’t craft while she is on you or the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, provide Masterwork upgrades for your allies’ completed items as soon as they become available to increase your team’s overall power.
Poppy.teamfight: Fight by intercepting Poppy’s engage in front of your carries. In a narrow passage with a wall, wait for Poppy W Steadfast Presence to end, then knock her up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge and follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God so the elemental passes through the enemies, then look for an angle to recast it and send it back toward your allies.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, don’t dash in with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Wait for it to end or walk up. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock’s first hit lands, walk out of the area before the second explosion. When you see Poppy charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her frontal path. Check the terrain behind you so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t pin you against a wall.

Renekton.build: Renekton’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If he chips you down with basic attacks and heals with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, get Thornmail earlier for its reflected damage and Grievous Wounds. Against the armor reduction from an empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice, position yourself to dodge the dash instead of stacking more resistances.
Renekton.combo: If Renekton E Slice and Dice is available, first lock him down with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God, then land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then add damage with a basic attack. Where there’s no wall, choose where to place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge.
Renekton.escape: Engage after Renekton E Slice and Dice and W Ruthless Predator are down. Especially if Renekton used E to disengage, close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God and find an angle to land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Renekton.fight: Trade briefly when Renekton is out of Fury. The window to fight back comes right after he uses Renekton Q Cull the Meek, W Ruthless Predator, and E Slice and Dice, especially after he uses E to disengage. Don’t extend the fight while Renekton R Dominus is active.
Renekton.laning: Ornn’s early damage is low, so use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to farm safely and keep up in levels. Poke Renekton when he steps forward to hit minions, but don’t stand among or behind a group of minions that Renekton E Slice and Dice can use as a foothold. If the wave pushes toward you, farm under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to craft items when it’s safe.
Renekton.phase: In the late game, empower your team by giving allies Masterwork upgrades with Ornn P Living Forge.
Renekton.teamfight: In a narrow area with a wall, knock Renekton up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then apply Brittle with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God so the elemental passes through the enemies, then recast it to look for a knock-up. Intercept Renekton’s engage and guard the space in front of your carries.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half full, keep your distance and watch out for the stun from an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Change your position so you aren’t among or behind a group of minions that Renekton E Slice and Dice can use to engage.

Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If she gets ahead or keeps hitting you with empowered basic attacks, get Thornmail earlier. Also build health so Riven R Blade of the Exile can’t finish you off when you’re low.
Riven.combo: If Riven still has a mobility ability available, cast Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to create a pillar, then knock her up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then finish with a basic attack. If Riven is already on you and has spent the mobility ability she could use to escape, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with a basic attack or the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge.
Riven.escape: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are both mobility abilities, so don’t engage just because one is down. Close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God when she has used her remaining mobility too, especially before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back up. If Riven W Ki Burst is also down, you can engage without worrying about its stun.
Riven.fight: Look to trade after Riven uses Q Broken Wings to clear minions or engage. Don’t use crowd control before she gets on you; interrupt the follow-up attack immediately after she engages with Ornn W Bellows Breath or Ornn E Searing Charge. If no ally is nearby, don’t spend all of Ornn E Searing Charge to engage; save it to disengage.
Riven.laning: If Riven pushes the wave, farm under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to finish items when she recalls. Don’t use the forge if Riven can engage while you’re crafting or the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Riven.phase: In the late game, increase your team’s overall strength with Masterwork upgrades for your allies instead of focusing on Ornn’s personal damage.
Riven.teamfight: Intercept Riven’s engage in front of your carries, and respond as soon as she gets on you with Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn E Searing Charge. In a narrow passage with a wall, knock her up by colliding with the wall using Ornn E Searing Charge, then overlap it with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God so the elemental passes through the enemies, then recast it to look for a knock-up.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings dashes three times and knocks you up on the last cast, while Riven W Ki Burst stuns. When you see the first dash, retreat beyond the range of her remaining dashes. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her attack damage and range increase, and it provides finishing damage that scales with missing health, so keep your distance until its duration ends.

Rumble.build: Given the damage from Rumble P Junkyard Titan, Q Flamespitter, and E Electro Harpoon, prioritize defensive items with magic resistance. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your max health, so avoid building heavily into health alone.
Rumble.combo: After Rumble W Scrap Shield’s shield disappears, use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to create a pillar, then knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath to apply Brittle, then add damage with a basic attack. If Rumble is already close and you have a clear knock-up angle, apply Brittle first with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then knock him up.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so a good window to engage is after you dodge Rumble E Electro Harpoon or after he uses both casts. If he has also used Rumble W Scrap Shield, close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God after its movement speed boost and shield end. If the first harpoon hits you, stop your engage and back off before the second.
Rumble.fight: Trade briefly and back off when Rumble has to walk forward. If Rumble activates W Scrap Shield, wait for the shield to disappear before dealing damage. If Rumble has no mobility and the W he could use to escape is also down, catch him with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God.
Rumble.laning: Ornn’s early damage is low, so use Q Volcanic Rupture to farm safely and keep up in levels. If Rumble pushes the wave, farm under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to finish items while he recalls. Crafting leaves you vulnerable, so don’t craft if Rumble is nearby or the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Rumble.phase: In the late game, increase your team’s power by upgrading your allies’ completed items to Masterwork items.
Rumble.teamfight: Fight around terrain, using Ornn E Searing Charge to collide with a wall and knock enemies up, then Ornn W Bellows Breath to apply Brittle. In open terrain, use Ornn R Call of the Forge God twice to send the elemental back and create a knock-up angle. Intercept the enemy’s engage in front of your carries instead of chasing Rumble recklessly.
Rumble.watch: Watch out for the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon. If both harpoons hit in a row, both the slow and the magic resistance reduction increase. If the first hits, use Ornn E Searing Charge to create distance before the second harpoon. Limit how long you stay close to avoid taking extended damage from Rumble Q Flamespitter.

Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett’s basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. If he keeps chipping you down with basic attacks, get Thornmail earlier. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your max health, and armor can’t mitigate the true damage in the center of Sett W Haymaker, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: The standard engage is to create a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock Sett up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. When trading at close range, land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with an empowered basic attack. If Sett R The Show Stopper is down and he has no way to escape, land Ornn W Bellows Breath first, then follow with the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge to make the most of Brittle.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, you can initiate with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge without worrying about its stun.
Sett.fight: Avoid long trades with Sett early. Deal damage briefly, then back off and wait for the Grit from Sett W Haymaker to fade. If Sett R The Show Stopper is down, you can close the gap and fight with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If no ally is nearby when you engage, save Ornn E Searing Charge for your escape.
Sett.laning: If Sett pushes the wave, farm under your turret, and use Ornn P Living Forge to finish items while Sett is away after recalling. Crafting takes time, so don’t craft if Sett is nearby or the enemy jungler’s position is unknown.
Sett.phase: In the late game, increase your team’s overall strength by providing Masterwork upgrades for your allies’ completed items.
Sett.teamfight: Sett R The Show Stopper can throw you toward your allies, so don’t stand on top of them while his ultimate is available. Intercept Sett’s engage in front of your carries. Where there’s a wall, knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, first slow him and apply Brittle with Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn E Searing Charge.
Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker is especially dangerous right after Sett takes damage, so briefly create distance after dealing damage. If it’s hard to dodge, move beside the indicator to avoid the true damage in its center. Sett E Facebreaker stuns if it catches targets on both sides of Sett, so don’t stand opposite him with minions or allies between you.

Shen.build: Use Ornn P Living Forge from a safe position to craft defensive items and stay in lane. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance. The time spent taunted is dangerous, so prioritize Tenacity, and account for max-health-based damage instead of building heavily into health alone.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash is down, choose where to place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then knock him up by colliding with it using Ornn E Searing Charge. Follow with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with a basic attack after Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends. If he is already close and you can delay the knock-up, apply Brittle first with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is Ornn’s chance to engage. If no ally is nearby, save Ornn E Searing Charge instead of spending it all to engage.
Shen.fight: If Shen E Shadow Dash misses, look for a knock-up angle with the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge. When trading at close range, land the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with a basic attack after Shen W Spirit’s Refuge ends.
Shen.laning: Keep up in CS and levels early, and farm under your turret if Shen pushes. When you can safely push, keep Shen occupied with CS to increase the cost of using Shen R Stand United to reach another lane. If Shen recalls or leaves lane with Shen R Stand United, take CS and pressure his turret. Use Ornn P Living Forge to craft items when it’s safe and no enemy is nearby.
Shen.phase: Ornn hits his power spike in the mid game after completing two or three defensive items. In the late game, increase your team’s power with Masterwork upgrades for your allies.
Shen.teamfight: In a narrow passage with a wall, knock enemies up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then overlap it with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God so the elemental passes through the enemies, then recast it to look for a knock-up. Intercept Shen E Shadow Dash’s engage and guard the space in front of your carries. If you see Shen R Stand United bringing him into the fight, judge whether you can finish the fight before he arrives.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you’re likely to take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so avoid its path. Also move out of the path where Shen Q Twilight Assault pulls his spirit blade back, and hold your basic attacks while Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active.

Singed.build: Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling both deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health, so rather than building heavily into health alone, also get movement speed to escape areas covered in poison. When crafting an item with Ornn P Living Forge, wait for a safe moment when Singed is far away and you know where the jungler is.
Singed.combo: If Singed is close and there is no adhesive on the ground, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then land an empowered basic attack. If you have an opening to knock him up, place the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up. When landing your abilities reliably matters more, lock him down first with E or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit W.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Singed W Mega Adhesive is not on the ground, look for a chance to engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. You can’t dash while on the adhesive, so go around it. Singed E Fling can throw you into a dangerous position, so check behind Singed before engaging.
Singed.fight: Ornn’s damage is low early, so don’t force long fights; trade briefly when Singed gets close. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so after avoiding the adhesive, look for a chance to catch him with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow up with an empowered basic attack.
Singed.laning: If Singed pushes the wave, farm under your turret and complete an item with Ornn P Living Forge during a safe opening. When Singed retreats while leaving poison behind, don’t give up CS to chase him.
Singed.phase: In the late game, upgrade your allies’ completed items to Masterwork items to increase your team’s power.
Singed.teamfight: When Singed charges at you, don’t chase him to the end. Keep him occupied with Ornn W Bellows Breath, Ornn E Searing Charge, and Ornn R Call of the Forge God while your allies attack Singed’s team. Ornn guards the space in front of his allied carries and looks for a knock-up with E near a wall. In open terrain, slow Singed and apply Brittle with R first, then follow up with E.
Singed.watch: Don’t chase low-health Singed while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. You can’t escape from Singed W Mega Adhesive with Ornn E Searing Charge, and if Singed hits you with E Fling while you’re on it, you’ll also be rooted, so go around the adhesive. If Singed has his back to allies, E Fling can send you into the enemy formation, so check his position and keep your distance.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor doesn’t help against Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer, and E also reduces your armor, so prioritize avoiding it. Keep in mind that P deals damage based on your maximum health, and be wary of relying on a large amount of health alone.
Sion.combo: If Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is available and you need to secure a hit first, lock him down with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If R is down and you’re already close, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then land an empowered basic attack. To look for a knock-up in open terrain, choose where the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture will stand and hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge.
Sion.escape: Bait out Sion Q Decimating Smash or dodge it to the side, then approach with Ornn E Searing Charge and hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If your allies aren’t nearby, don’t spend E entirely to engage and leave yourself without a way out.
Sion.fight: Move to the side to avoid Sion Q Decimating Smash as he charges it, and if you can’t dodge, pressure him to release it early by staying close. When Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught is down, close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Once close, hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then land an empowered basic attack.
Sion.laning: If Sion pushes the wave, farm under your turret and complete an item with Ornn P Living Forge while he’s away recalling. Sion gains maximum health as he farms, so if you can’t safely disrupt his farming, make plays in another lane.
Sion.phase: In the late game, increase your team’s power with Masterwork upgrades for your allies, but don’t let Sion keep farming and drag the game out.
Sion.teamfight: Counter Sion’s engage near a wall by hitting it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up, then layer Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, summon Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then recast it to intercept the spirit, and guard the space in front of your allied carries. Position so you don’t take Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught head-on in a narrow passage, and reposition when Sion P Glory in Death activates.
Sion.watch: Sion Q Decimating Smash becomes more threatening the longer it charges, with a knock-up and stun, so move to the side when he starts charging. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; sidestep its direction of travel.
