After Sion revives with Sion P Glory in Death, he attacks quickly and deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay where he fell; reposition and keep your distance.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval and E Ixtal's Impact deal physical damage, so you also need armor. Since Skarner deals damage based on your maximum health, get movement speed to escape telegraphed areas instead of relying on a large amount of health alone.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is available, create a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, knock him up by hitting it with Ornn E Searing Charge, and follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath to secure the hit. If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down and you’re already close, apply Brittle with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow up with an empowered basic attack or the knock-up from E Searing Charge. To place the pillar where you want it, account for the fact that Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture stops where it hits Skarner.
Skarner.escape: The moment after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down is your opening to engage. Close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God, then hit with W Bellows Breath. If Skarner R Impale is available, don’t count on escaping its suppression with Ornn E Searing Charge.
Skarner.fight: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God. Once close, hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then push him back and deal damage with an empowered basic attack. Don’t spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely to engage when your allies aren’t nearby.
Skarner.laning: Don’t force an early advantage; farm safely with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and keep up in CS and levels. Farm pushed-in waves under your turret, and when Skarner recalls, complete an item with Ornn P Living Forge and stay in lane. Crafting takes time, so don’t craft when Skarner is close or you don’t know where the jungler is.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, upgrade your allies’ completed items to Masterwork items to increase your team’s power.
Skarner.teamfight: Counter Skarner’s engage in front of your allied carries and, if possible, knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge in a passage with a wall, then follow with W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, look for an angle to sweep over enemies with Ornn R Call of the Forge God and recast it to send the spirit back toward your allies. At the edges of the Dragon or Baron pit, don’t stand against a wall, since Skarner R Impale can catch you and drag you over the terrain.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact dashes through terrain, and he stuns you if he catches you and slams you into a wall. Don’t stand with your back to a wall; if you’re hit into one, retreat while accounting for his next dash. You can’t remove Skarner R Impale’s suppression with Ornn E Searing Charge, so keep distance between Skarner and his allies.

Teemo.build: Buy magic resistance items first to counter the main damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap. You can craft items in lane with Ornn P Living Forge, but don’t craft when Teemo is nearby or the enemy jungler’s location is unclear.
Teemo.combo: In open terrain, choose where the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture will stand, then hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock Teemo up. Follow with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, and land an empowered basic attack when Teemo Q Blinding Dart’s blind ends. When using Ornn R Call of the Forge God, let the spirit pass through Teemo first, then recast to headbutt and redirect the spirit so it knocks him up.
Teemo.escape: Engage when Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down so the empowered attack after Ornn W Bellows Breath won’t be blocked by the blind. Right after Teemo uses W Move Quick is also an opportunity to close the distance; engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If your allies aren’t nearby, don’t spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely to engage and leave yourself without a way out.
Teemo.fight: Look for a trading opportunity after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down. Avoid short trades where you’re hit by Teemo E Toxic Shot and immediately retreat; if you decide to fight, close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge and hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Teemo.laning: If Teemo pushes the wave, farm under your turret, and complete an item with Ornn P Living Forge when Teemo recalls. Don’t approach bushes without vision, keeping Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare’s stealth in mind.
Teemo.phase: In the late game, increase your team’s power with Masterwork upgrades for your allies.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Traps in front of objectives and in narrow passages as you move. Near a wall, start the fight with a knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge and layer Ornn W Bellows Breath. Counter the enemy engage in front of your allied carries, and use available Masterwork upgrades on your allies.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so if you’re hit, delay the empowered attack after Ornn W Bellows Breath until the blind ends. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies poison damage even from a single basic attack, so stay outside his attack range when you’re not ready to engage. Teemo R Noxious Trap is hidden and slows you, so be careful when passing through key paths and narrow passages.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Options that reduce the attack speed he gains from Trundle W Frozen Domain are also useful, but while Trundle R Subjugate is stealing your resistances, prioritize creating distance over stacking more resistance. If healing from Trundle P King's Tribute makes him difficult to kill in a long fight, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Trundle.combo: If Trundle is close and you can fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with a basic attack. To follow up with a knock-up, choose the pillar’s location and cast Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then hit the pillar with Ornn E Searing Charge. When you need to catch him reliably, knock him up first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Trundle.escape: Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage after he uses Trundle E Pillar of Ice, when you have an escape route. Use Ornn W Bellows Breath to push through the remaining slow and knockback, then close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If your allies aren’t nearby, don’t spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely to engage; save it as a way out.
Trundle.fight: Back away from Trundle W Frozen Domain and fight after its effect ends. You can push through the slow and knockback from Trundle E Pillar of Ice with Ornn W Bellows Breath’s unstoppable effect, and destroy the pillar itself with Ornn E Searing Charge. For trades, hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trigger Brittle with a basic attack.
Trundle.laning: Early on, focus on safe farming with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and keeping up in CS and levels instead of trying to gain an advantage by fighting Trundle. Avoid long poke trades across a large wave, since deaths of nearby units heal Trundle through P King's Tribute. Farm pushed-in waves under your turret and safely complete an item with Ornn P Living Forge when he recalls.
Trundle.phase: Once you have two or three defensive items in the mid game, start team fights. In the late game, upgrade your allies’ completed items to Masterwork items to increase your team’s power.
Trundle.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths where Trundle E Pillar of Ice can block your escape, and fight where there’s a wall for Ornn E Searing Charge to hit. Don’t leave your front line alone to withstand Trundle R Subjugate; while Trundle is tougher from its effect, attack another target or create distance.
Trundle.watch: When you’re in an area covered by Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed and healing increase, so back away and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape and slows nearby, so immediately move to the side or destroy it with Ornn E Searing Charge. When Trundle R Subjugate is active, it steals your armor and magic resistance, so create distance and don’t face him alone during that time.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Since he pressures you with constant basic attacks, get Thornmail early for reflected damage and healing reduction.
Tryndamere.combo: If Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then land an empowered basic attack. To follow with a knock-up, create a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge. If Tryndamere still has E Spinning Slash and securing a hit comes first, lock him down with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with W.
Tryndamere.escape: Engage immediately after forcing Tryndamere to use E Spinning Slash. Close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath. Right after you’re hit by Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, avoid trading basic attacks because your attack damage is reduced.
Tryndamere.fight: The moment after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your chance to fight. Hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then trade with an empowered basic attack. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God instead of trying to deal more damage.
Tryndamere.laning: If Tryndamere pushes the wave, farm under your turret and safely complete an item with Ornn P Living Forge when he recalls. When backing away while mindful of Tryndamere W Mocking Shout, walk backward while facing him.
Tryndamere.phase: In the late game, increase your team’s power with Masterwork upgrades for your allies, and don’t try to stop Tryndamere alone in a side lane.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Ornn counters Tryndamere’s engage in front of allied carries. In a passage with a wall, knock Tryndamere up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with Ornn’s knock-ups and look for a chance to deal damage after it ends.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury’s critical strikes are dangerous, so create distance when he starts building Fury by attacking minions. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash comes back sooner when he critically strikes among minions, so don’t chase him through the wave. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, don’t pour in damage; buy time with knock-ups and distance.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage, and get ways to reduce the damage he relies on basic attacks and attack speed to deal. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle makes him difficult to kill through sustained trades, upgrade Oblivion Orb to Morellonomicon to maintain healing reduction.
Udyr.combo: If Udyr E Blazing Stampede is available, create a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up first, then hit with Ornn W Bellows Breath.
Udyr.escape: The opening to counterattack or escape is after you’ve absorbed one stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede or right after he uses that movement ability. If Udyr is empowered by E, immobilizing effects won’t work, so wait for the empowerment to end before catching him with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Udyr.fight: After baiting out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, close the distance with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, hit with the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then follow with an empowered basic attack.
Udyr.laning: When Udyr is out of sight, don’t move forward; use vision on key paths and jungle entrances to watch for gank routes. After the enemy recalls, safely craft an item with Ornn P Living Forge.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, provide Masterwork upgrades for your allies’ completed items as soon as they become available to increase your team’s power.
Udyr.teamfight: Ornn counters Udyr’s engage in front of allied carries and fights around terrain. In passages with a wall, knock Udyr up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath; if Udyr is empowered by E, save immobilizing effects until the empowerment ends. Instead of trying to burn through Udyr while he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle, protect the frontline so your allies can take out the weaker enemies behind him first.
Udyr.watch: Be wary of the stun just after Udyr activates E Blazing Stampede. You can meet his approach with the unstoppable effect of Ornn W Bellows Breath. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of long trades.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If you’re on the frontline and taking repeated basic attacks from him, build Thornmail earlier.
Urgot.combo: Once Urgot E Disdain is down, use Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to raise a pillar, then hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack. To place the pillar where you want it, account for Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture stopping where it hits Urgot.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility tool, so just after it’s down is your window to engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Conversely, if Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits and it’s hard to walk away, immediately decide whether to escape with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Urgot.fight: While Urgot E Disdain is available, it’s easy for him to avoid the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, so bait it out first. Just after Urgot E Disdain is down, briefly engage and hit him with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack. After the trade, move out of his short range so Urgot P Echoing Flames can’t keep hitting you.
Urgot.laning: If Urgot pushes the wave, farm under your turret. When he recalls, use Ornn P Living Forge to finish an item while staying in lane. Avoid crafting while Urgot is nearby or the jungler’s position is unknown.
Urgot.phase: In the late game, provide Masterwork upgrades to allies to increase your team’s power.
Urgot.teamfight: Stand in front of your carries and counter Urgot E Disdain’s engage. In a walled corridor, knock him up by charging into the wall with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so hold the frontline to protect the carries behind you.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on maximum health, so don’t stay near him for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you receive its strong slow and focused fire from Urgot W Purge. Dodge it as it comes in; if it hits, immediately decide whether to escape with Ornn E Searing Charge. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get out of range before health reaches the execute threshold.

Volibear.build: Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on your max health, so avoid heavily stacking health alone. If Volibear W Frenzied Maul’s healing makes it hard to finish him, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Volibear.combo: If Volibear Q Thundering Smash and R Stormbringer are available, lock him down first with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If his mobility is down and he’s close, apply Brittle with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then land a basic attack or the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge. In open terrain, choose where to raise the Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture pillar, then hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up.
Volibear.escape: Don’t engage just because Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down. Wait until Volibear R Stormbringer is also down, then close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or R Call of the Forge God, especially before that ability comes back up, and follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. If Volibear is approaching with Volibear Q Thundering Smash, stay beyond basic attack range, avoid the stun, and wait for an opening.
Volibear.fight: If Volibear has built up P The Relentless Storm stacks by attacking minions, don’t take a fight; wait until the stacks fall off. Move sideways out of the marked area for Volibear E Sky Splitter, and hit him with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath just after he uses Volibear Q Thundering Smash or R Stormbringer to move. If you can’t finish him, break off a long fight that would let Volibear W Frenzied Maul heal him.
Volibear.laning: If Volibear pushes the wave, farm under your turret. Craft items with Ornn P Living Forge while Volibear is away after recalling. Crafting takes time, so don’t do it while Volibear is nearby or the jungler’s position is unknown.
Volibear.phase: Early on, Ornn’s ability cooldowns are long and his damage is low, so farm instead of fighting Volibear for an advantage. In the late game, use Ornn’s Masterwork item upgrades on allies to strengthen the team.
Volibear.teamfight: When Volibear engages, counter him from in front of your carries, and use the terrain to chain the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge into Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, look for an angle to let the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God sweep through enemies, then recast to send it back toward your team. If Volibear has fully stacked P The Relentless Storm, don’t take the fight right away; engage after the stacks fall off.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear activates Volibear Q Thundering Smash and approaches, watch for the stun on his empowered basic attack and run out the clock beyond his basic attack range. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, move to the side to avoid its damage and slow. At low health, watch for a turret dive with Volibear R Stormbringer and retreat deep under your turret.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal physical damage, so build armor first. If he keeps chipping away with basic attacks, build Thornmail earlier. Keep in mind that armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: After Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down, choose where to place the Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture pillar and cast it, then hit it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock him up. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath, then use a basic attack to trigger Brittle’s bonus damage. If Yasuo is already close and you can land the final flame, apply Brittle with W first, then knock him up with E to get more value from the crowd control.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado is down is your chance to engage. Don’t go deep just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down; look for an angle to land the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God together with Ornn W Bellows Breath before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no knock-up available, creating a chance to fight. First, use light poke such as Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture to break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield. Then trade just after Yasuo dashes away with E Sweeping Blade, landing the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath as well.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can use to dash in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade. If the lane is pushed in, farm under your turret. While the opponent is away after recalling, craft items with Ornn P Living Forge from a safe position.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Ornn lacks damage and the ability uptime to fight effectively, so focus on matching Yasuo’s CS and level instead of trying to beat him. In the late game, upgrade your main carry’s completed item to a Masterwork item to strengthen the team.
Yasuo.teamfight: Counter Yasuo’s engage and protect your carries from the front. In a narrow corridor, use a wall to knock him up with Ornn E Searing Charge, then follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, let the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God pass through the enemy, then recast to knock them up and look for an angle to follow with Ornn E Searing Charge.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks enemies up. When you see the stack indicator, dodge sideways out of its line. Yasuo can use minions as stepping stones to close in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and if you’re knocked up he can follow with Yasuo R Last Breath, so watch his approach path too.

Yone.build: When you can safely stay in lane, use Ornn P Living Forge to finish a defensive item first. Yone deals a mix of physical and magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Keep in mind that Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Movement speed and attack speed reduction also help you dodge Yone’s telegraphed attacks and delay his tornado cycle.
Yone.combo: If Yone still has a mobility ability available, lock him down first with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God, then follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack. In open terrain, when looking for Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture → Ornn E Searing Charge, choose where to raise the pillar before casting Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down; check Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed too. In particular, close the gap with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God while Yone R Fate Sealed is down and he has also used his other mobility ability. If Yone engages first with Yone E Soul Unbound, try to hold your knock-up to stop his return.
Yone.fight: Don’t engage first while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready. If Yone engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to hold your knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God and stop his return.
Yone.laning: If Yone pushes the wave, farm under your turret. Once Yone has recalled, use Ornn P Living Forge to finish an item and stay in lane. Crafting takes time, so don’t do it while Yone is nearby or the jungler’s position is unknown.
Yone.phase: In the late game, provide Masterwork upgrades for allies’ completed items as soon as they become available to strengthen the team.
Yone.teamfight: Counter Yone’s engage from in front of your carries, and spread out so several allies don’t get hit together by Yone W Spirit Cleave. Fight around terrain and, after Yone engages, lock him down with the wall collision knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or the knock-up from Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Ornn R Call of the Forge God only knocks up when you recast to headbutt the spirit after summoning it, so line up the recast to send the spirit back toward your team after it passes through the enemy.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado is ready, so stay out of range until the stacks disappear. After Yone uses Yone E Soul Unbound to engage, he can deal extra damage when he returns, so create distance in advance if your health is low. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so before a teamfight, make sure you aren’t alone at the very back of your formation.

Yorick.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on your max health, so be wary of heavily stacking health alone. If Yorick Q Last Rites’ healing makes it hard to finish him in an extended fight, get healing reduction with Oblivion Orb and upgrade it to Morellonomicon.
Yorick.combo: In open terrain, raise a pillar with Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, then charge into it with Ornn E Searing Charge to knock Yorick up. Follow with the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath and an empowered basic attack to trigger Brittle. If you’re already close to Yorick, apply Brittle first with Ornn W Bellows Breath, then land the knock-up from Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Yorick.escape: The moment after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist is your chance to step forward. If Yorick W Dark Procession is also down, you can worry less about being trapped by the wall and engage with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. Yorick has no mobility, so once you catch him, landing Ornn W Bellows Breath as well makes it hard for him to escape.
Yorick.fight: Don’t start a fight where many graves and Mist Walkers have built up; clear the Mist Walkers before engaging. After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, step forward to farm. When you engage, catch Yorick while he has no mobility with Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God. If no ally is nearby, don’t spend Ornn E Searing Charge entirely on engaging, since you need it in case of Yorick W Dark Procession.
Yorick.laning: Avoid fighting where Yorick has many graves. When possible, let the wave die under Yorick’s turret to limit his chance to build up graves. Step forward to farm while Yorick E Mourning Mist is down, and use a safe window to finish an item with Ornn P Living Forge.
Yorick.phase: Early on, Ornn’s ability cooldowns are long and his damage is low, so focus on safe farming instead of forcing fights. In the late game, apply Masterwork upgrades to allies’ completed items to strengthen the team.
Yorick.teamfight: In a narrow, walled corridor, knock enemies up with Ornn E Searing Charge and follow with Ornn W Bellows Breath. In open terrain, cast Ornn R Call of the Forge God first to slow enemies and apply Brittle, then look for a knock-up. Counter Yorick’s engage from in front of your carries, and while Yorick is pushing a side lane, look for opportunities to trade for objectives elsewhere.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows and marks you and deals damage based on your max health, so watch its trajectory and dodge. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, hit the wall to break it or destroy the terrain with Ornn E Searing Charge. If the Maiden of the Mist starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
